title: How Did Tiny Austria End Up Ruling Europe?

subtitles.text: How did tiny Austria end up ruling most of Europe?
Austria started in 976 as a small frontier march to protect Central Europe from nomadic raids.
Over the next 270 years, it was slowly transformed from a border outpost into a proper Duchy.
Then in 1273, Rudolph of Habsburg won election as Holy Roman Emperor.
Rudolph immediately seized Austria and Styria, followed by Carinthia.
From there, the Habsburgs played the ultimate long game: expanding through marriage into Burgundy, Spain, and Hungary.
